walking_route_clear_width.label: clear width of a walking route or corridor

door_clear_width.label: clear width of a door opening

handrail_height.label: height of the top of a handrail above the walking surface

ballast_water_exchange_efficiency.label: volumetric efficiency of ballast water exchange

turning_space_diameter.label: diameter of a wheelchair turning space

door_threshold_height.label: height of a threshold at a doorway

toilet_seat_height.label: height of a toilet or water closet seat above the floor

table_counter_height.label: height of the top of a table, counter, dining or work surface

high_forward_reach_height.label: height of a control or item reached forward from a wheelchair (high reach)

superstructure_door_sill_height.label: sill height of an access opening in an end bulkhead of an enclosed superstructure

guard_rail_height.label: height of bulwarks or guard rails on exposed decks

rules.title: Clear width of walking surfaces
rules.exceptions: May be reduced to 32 inches (815 mm) minimum for a length of 24 inches (610 mm) maximum, and 403.5.2 and 403.5.3 also apply.

source.quote: the clear width of walking surfaces shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.

rules.title: Clear width of walking surfaces on passenger vessels
rules.exceptions: May be reduced to 32 inches (815 mm) minimum for a length of 24 inches (610 mm) maximum, and V403.5.2 and V403.5.3 also apply.

source.quote: the clear width of walking surfaces shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.

rules.title: Clear width of door openings
rules.exceptions: Openings more than 24 inches (610 mm) deep need 36 inches (915 mm) minimum. Measure swinging doors between the door face and the stop with the door open 90 degrees.

source.quote: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.

rules.title: Clear width of door openings on passenger vessels
rules.exceptions: Openings more than 24 inches (610 mm) deep need 36 inches (915 mm) minimum. Measure swinging doors between the door face and the stop with the door open 90 degrees.

source.quote: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.

rules.title: Running slope of ramps
rules.exceptions: Existing sites, buildings and facilities may use the steeper slopes in Table 405.2 where space is limited.

source.quote: Ramp runs shall have a running slope not steeper than 1:12.

rules.title: Running slope of ramps on passenger vessels
rules.exceptions: Alterations may use Table V405.2 where space is limited. A slope steeper than 1:8 is prohibited.

source.quote: Ramp runs shall have a running slope not steeper than 1:12.

rules.title: Handrail height
rules.required_text: 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum
rules.exceptions: Handrails must also be at a consistent height above walking surfaces, stair nosings and ramp surfaces.

source.quote: Top of gripping surfaces of handrails shall be 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum

rules.title: Handrail height on passenger vessels
rules.required_text: 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum
rules.exceptions: Applies above walking surfaces, stair nosings, gangway surfaces and ramp surfaces. Check the exceptions in V503.4.

source.quote: Top of gripping surfaces of handrails shall be 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum

rules.title: Ballast water exchange efficiency
rules.exceptions: Pumping through three times the volume of each ballast tank is considered to meet the standard.

source.quote: shall do so with an efficiency of at least 95 percent volumetric exchange of ballast water.

rules.title: Circular turning space
rules.exceptions: A T-shaped space complying with 304.3.2 is also allowed. Knee and toe clearance complying with 306 may be included.

source.quote: The turning space shall be a space of 60 inches (1525 mm) diameter minimum.

rules.title: Circular turning space on passenger vessels
rules.exceptions: A T-shaped space complying with V304.3.2 is also allowed.

source.quote: The turning space shall be a space of 60 inches (1525 mm) diameter minimum.

rules.title: Door thresholds
rules.exceptions: Existing or altered thresholds up to 3/4 inch (19 mm) with a beveled edge on each side are allowed. Passenger vessel coamings are treated differently in PVAG V404.2.5.

source.quote: Thresholds, if provided at doorways, shall be ½ inch (13 mm) high maximum.

rules.title: Water closet seat height
rules.required_text: 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum
rules.exceptions: Exceptions apply to single-occupant toilet rooms reached through a private office, and to children's toilets.

source.quote: shall be 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum measured to the top of the seat.

rules.title: Water closet seat height on passenger vessels
rules.required_text: 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum

source.quote: shall be 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum measured to the top of the seat.

rules.title: Dining and work surface height
rules.required_text: 28 inches (710 mm) minimum and 34 inches (865 mm) maximum
rules.exceptions: Surfaces for children have different heights (902.4).

source.quote: The tops of dining surfaces and work surfaces shall be 28 inches (710 mm) minimum and 34 inches (865 mm) maximum

rules.title: Table and counter height on passenger vessels
rules.required_text: 28 inches (710 mm) minimum and 34 inches (865 mm) maximum
rules.exceptions: 15 to 17 inches (380 to 430 mm) is allowed where the clear deck spaces are provided as described in the exception.

source.quote: The tops of tables and counters shall be 28 inches (710 mm) minimum and 34 inches (865 mm) maximum

rules.title: Unobstructed high forward reach
rules.exceptions: Applies where the forward reach is unobstructed. The low forward reach must be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum.

source.quote: the high forward reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum

rules.title: Unobstructed high forward reach on passenger vessels
rules.exceptions: Applies where the forward reach is unobstructed. The low forward reach must be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum.

source.quote: the high forward reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum

rules.title: Sills of access openings in superstructure end bulkheads
rules.exceptions: 'Except as otherwise provided in these regulations': other Load Line regulations, such as 18 for deckhouses and companionways, set different sill heights.

source.quote: the height of the sills of access openings in bulkheads at ends of enclosed superstructures shall be at least 380 mm above the deck.

rules.title: Height of bulwarks or guard rails
rules.exceptions: A lesser height may be approved where 1 m would interfere with the normal operation of the ship and adequate protection is provided.

source.quote: The height of the bulwarks or guard rails shall be at least 1 m from the deck
